observations: body L1: in the head the dash after «p)» measures 10.3 pt and is transcribed as a dash; that of «27–31» is a long dash (5.3 pt).
body L2, L11, L13-L14, L17, L26, L35: the dashes of «al–Battānī» and of «29–30» and «234–235» are long dashes (5.2 to 5.4 pt).

body L4-L12: al-Battānī's middle diameters, 32′ 30″ of the Sun and 32′ 25″ of the Moon, are the means of his extremes, 31′ 20″ and 33′ 40″, and 29′ 30″ and 35′ 20″ (the 29′ 1/2 and 35′ 1/3 of p. 58); the lines of diameters stand at their printed places.
body L8: the 4 of «32′ 36″,48» prints broken.
body L21-L22: the rough breathings of «ὁρᾶσθαι» and «ὅλον» are joined to the tops of their omicrons, so that both look like a delta; the omicrons of «ἐμποδιζόμενον» print open.
body L33-L34: specks after «Eudosso» and around «di Brera» are not transcribed.
body L35: a heavy bracket opens Schiaparelli's addition, which goes on to p. 237.
notes_right L4: the dash before «Cfr.» measures 8.5 pt and is transcribed as a dash.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
